summary: Stop BuilderOS from certifying false completion. Phase 0 hardens seal correctness; later phases build blueprint authority, decision records, runtime convergence, and revenue closure.
post_completion_followups: Update docs/products/builderos/PRODUCT_HOME.md and docs/CONTINUITY_LOG.md with Phase 0 completion summary.
Add FACTORY-BUILDEROS-CONVERGENCE-0001 to builderos-reboot/BP_PRIORITY.json as a completed or active item.
Write Mission 3 scoping note describing what is now cheaper/faster.

coder_must_not_decide: what counts as proof if the blueprint did not define it
whether a semantic answer is good enough when acceptance is soft
whether stale authority can be reused
whether a design principle can be weakened for convenience

non_goals: No Chair redesign from scratch; preserve the SO-003 regression test.
No email-provider migration until a provider is configured and verified.
No new comprehensive audit beyond the readiness audit; build only what enforces and verifies convergence.
No broad refactor of unrelated systems.

phases.title: Independent reasoning, consensus, and blueprint amendment
Gate all relevant construction and shipping paths
Decision-aware Wisdom, scorecard, runtime convergence, Collaboration Spine completion, and Mission 3 handoff

steps.title: Record Phase 0 consensus decision
required_edits: Create builderos-reboot/DECISIONS/DECISION-0001.md with the five consensus decisions from the founder/ChatGPT/Claude Code.
Update BLUEPRINT.json execution_gate to OPEN and phase order so P0 precedes P1.
Update FOUNDER_PACKET.md to reference DECISION-0001.md and the corrected sequencing.

must_prove: DECISION-0001.md exists and contains all five consensus points.
BLUEPRINT.json has execution_gate OPEN and P0 before P1.

steps.title: WP0.1 — Implement semantic grounding check before seal
required_edits: Create services/blueprint-grounding-check.js exporting verifyGeneratedContentGrounding({ filePath, content, knownSchemaFiles, rejectedHashes, logger }) returning { status: 'PASS' | 'FAIL' | 'INDETERMINATE', reason, details }.

Implement deterministic checks: (a) every named import resolves to an exported symbol in the source module; (b) every SQL FROM/INTO/JOIN/UPDATE/DELETE table exists in db/migrations/*.sql or live information_schema; (c) content hash is not in rejectedHashes.
Integrate the check into sealExactChangeIntoTwin before setting step.exactness.sealed; return { ok: false, status: 'GROUNDING_FAIL' | 'GROUNDING_INDETERMINATE', ... } when not PASS.
Integrate the check into runNextStep before step.status = DONE and into claimPreExistingSatisfiedSteps before marking a pre-existing step DONE.
Update routes/factory-mount-routes.js to skip sealing and append a historian record on grounding failure; the queue response must surface grounding failures.
Add tests proving missing export fails, missing SQL table fails, known-good file passes, rejected hash fails.

must_prove: npm run builder:preflight passes after integration.

steps.title: WP0.2 — Implement auditable unseal + anti-reseal
required_edits: Add export function unsealExactChangeInTwin({ blueprint_id, blueprint_step_id, unsealed_by, unseal_reason, evidence, repoRoot }) to services/truth-ladder.js.

The function clears step.exactness.sealed, exact_inputs, and content_sha256; preserves the prior content_sha256 in step.rejected_content_hashes[]; sets step.unsealed_at, step.unsealed_by, step.unseal_reason, step.unseal_evidence; writes the twin back to disk.
Add POST /factory/unseal-step route in routes/factory-mount-routes.js protected by guard that calls unsealExactChangeInTwin and records a historian event.
Ensure sealExactChangeIntoTwin refuses to seal when the computed content_sha256 is in step.rejected_content_hashes[].
Add tests: unseal synthetic step, confirm rejected hash list, reseal same content fails.

steps.title: WP0.3 — Implement sticky escalation for manual blocked steps
required_edits: Add export function escalateBlockedStep(queue, stepId, { escalation_note, escalated_by }) to services/product-build-orchestrator.js.
It sets step.escalation_required = true, step.escalation_note, step.escalated_at, step.escalated_by, and persists the queue.
Add POST /factory/escalate-step route in routes/factory-mount-routes.js protected by guard that calls escalateBlockedStep.
Verify reviveStaleBlockedSteps skips steps with escalation_required === true across simulated cooldown cycles, but still revives ordinary blocked steps (additive behavior).
Add tests for both cases.

must_prove: Escalated blocked step remains blocked over multiple revive cycles; ordinary blocked step still revives.

steps.title: WP0.4 — Trace the overwrite path and fix the smallest root cause
required_edits: Trace trigger -> selected blueprint step -> generation/replay source -> write operation -> seal operation -> commit/deploy path for the observed overwrite of manually repaired files.
Record exact evidence in docs/audits/builderos-mission-2/OVERWRITE_PATH_TRACE.md.
Implement only the narrow unambiguous correction (e.g., rejected hash block in seal, or source selection fix) or stop and create an ambiguity record if a Chair/Architect/founder decision is required.

must_prove: OVERWRITE_PATH_TRACE.md contains the complete chain, exact files/scheduler, and the smallest corrective action taken or the ambiguity question if blocked.

steps.title: WP0.5 — Extend self-repair-decision-log.js schema and write/read path
required_edits: Extend self_repair_decision_log table with explicit columns: decision_id, product_id, blueprint_id, blueprint_version, founder_intent, problem_statement, consensus_status, consensus_rationale, predicted_outcome, success_criteria, failure_criteria, decided_at, reality_check_at, reality_outcome, updated_at. And JSONB metadata column for alternatives_considered, per_role_reasoning, assumptions, objections_and_challenges, evidence, implementation_trace, sentry_verification, resulting_lessons, linked_artifacts, cost_and_efficiency_analysis.
Update recordFactoryDecision and getDecisionLog to support the extended shape while preserving backward compatibility for old callers.
Make the migration additive: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS then ALTER TABLE ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS for each new column.
Add test proving an extended decision round-trips and an old-style decision still writes/reads.

steps.title: Phase 0 stop-gate and handoff
required_edits: Create products/receipts/PHASE_0_STOP_GATE.json with ok, evidence for WP0.1–WP0.5, remaining undetected cases, and git_sha.
Update docs/audits/builderos-mission-2/MISSION_2_CONVERGENCE_HANDOFF.md with Phase 0 status.
Run npm run builder:preflight and record the result.

must_prove: PHASE_0_STOP_GATE.json states exactly what remains undetected.
